text: Several years ago, we warned during the Trump tax cuts that this dramatic decrease in revenue would explode the nation's debt. And we heard from the Republican side, no, let us write off our yachts. Let us write off our private jets. And we said that this decrease in revenue would explode.

text: and explode our national debt. But instead now of realizing the error of our ways and reversing these tax cuts for the wealthy, we are now seeing the Republican side promote a bill that cuts student loan cancellation, veterans healthcare, cancer research, opioid treatment, meals on wheels and more.
